name: Volley
description: Loose a rapid spread of arrows at your target, dealing damage based on your Agility.
flavor_text: One of them will find the gap.

name: Camouflage
description: You blend into your surroundings by instinct, making it easier to evade incoming blows.
flavor_text: They swing at where you were.

name: Nature's Bond
description: When you bring down a foe, the wild returns a share of its life to you, restoring HP.
flavor_text: Nothing in the forest is wasted.

name: Eagle Eye
description: Your sight sharpens to a predator's focus, raising your chance to crit on every attack.
flavor_text: You see the weak point before they know they have one.
